t: Show mercy down here and it comes from above
a: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ ارْحَمُوا أَهْلَ الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
p: Ar-rāḥimūna yarḥamuhumu-r-Raḥmān. Irḥamū ahla-l-arḍi yarḥamkum man fi-s-samāʾ
m: The merciful are shown mercy by the Merciful. Have mercy on those on earth and the One above will have mercy on you.
